about: Voices for singer source 'svs' (engine/svs.py). Pick one with "voice": "<id>". Descriptions, measurements and auditions: docs/voice/VOICES.md. Every voice here is licence-clean for Spectre's CC BY 4.0 tracks only with the credit line given; never use a Lotte V voice in a track with a political subject.

voices.range: A3-D5 (usable G3-F5; most data G3-D5, peak G4)
voices.settings: defaults; mix chain: docs/MANUAL.md 'Voices' (svs mix example)
defaults; cuts through a dense mix with less presence boost

voices.range: A3-C5 (soft modes thin out on top)
voices.settings: give it 1-2 dB more level or a quieter bed than the other modes
hanami Root with gender -0.5 (formants down); less intelligible than hanami: keep the bed sparse

voices.range: A3-D5 (assumed from Hanami's data; not measured)
voices.settings: beta voicebank: check every render; narrow vibrato (about 18 cents)
the brightest voice in the set: cut 3-5 kHz rather than adding presence
the breathiest voice in the set (aperiodicity 0.18)

controls.gender: -1..1 (0): formant shift; negative = formants down (darker, larger, older), positive = up (brighter, younger). Measured on hanami: -0.5 F1/F2 617/987 -> 498/1009 Hz. Not a male voice: at -1 an octave down it stays a low female voice (examples/vocals/svs/voices/ctl-hanami-male-fake.mp3).
controls.velocity: 0.5..2 (1): consonant speed; small effect on these banks
controls.mix: a voice entry may give "mix": {mode: weight} instead of "mode" to blend vocal modes (speaker embeddings interpolated)
controls.not available: these banks have no breathiness, tension, voicing or energy controls (their models were trained without them)
